results.name: Lowpoly Tools - Free Download
results.description:
A bunch of rusty tools, scanned directly from my toolbox, and optimized to lowpoly PBR props with Open Source tools only: Colmap, OpenMVS, Blender and [BakeMyScan](http://bakemyscan.org) !

Should you need them, all the LODs you might ever dream of for this collection are [available on the Store](https://skfb.ly/6FSYn):

* 15k tris - 4096px
* 5k tris - 2048px
* 1.5k tris - 1024px
* 500 tris - 512px (the ones you see here!)
* 150 tris - 256px

These assets are especially optimized for realtime applications: VR, AR, WebGL, game engines, mobile apps, kitbashing... Here is an example of particle instancing with those props: ["The Toolball"](https://skfb.ly/6FSYs).

Licensed under **CC-attribution**: feel free to re-use them with the appropriate credit, and do not hesitate to drop a comment if you used them for your own creations, I'd be happy to know. 

And if you enjoyed those assets, you might find other interesting stuff in [this lowpoly collection](https://skfb.ly/6FSYx) ;)

results.name: Free Low Poly Forest
results.description:
This Free Low Poly Forest Pack contains 23 unique assets from the [Ultimate Low Poly Nature Pack](http://skfb.ly/o7QpY) and allows you to build your own forest!

This free pack contains 1% of the assets present in the Ultimate Low Poly Nature Pack.

For demonstration purposes, all models are displayed in a list scene and arranged in a big demo scene. 

**–Texture–**

All objects share the same 256x256 texture to increase performance. Game ready assets suitable for mobile games & VR/AR experience.

**–Package Content–**

- Terrain Tiles (4x) – Meadow, Lake
- Mountains (2x)
- Flowers (3x) – Hyacinth, Sunflower, Daffodil
- Grass (2x)
- Rocks (4x) 
- Mushrooms (4x) – Yellow and Purple
- Trees (4x) – Birch Trees, Fir Trees

The Ultimate Low Poly Nature Pack can be purchased via the link below:

[Ultimate Low Poly Nature Pack](http://skfb.ly/o7QpY)



Leave a like & comment if you like this free pack!


Any feedback can be shared via **purepoly.info@gmail.com. **

results.name: Hangar / Storage Room Asset Pack
results.description:
Here's some quick envioronment assets I made to fill out the space in the game I worked on, *Iron Horizon*. Our team needed more large structures to break up the space as well as to add visual interest to the environment. Note that some assets are painted a bright yellow to identify them as destructible in-game.
***This pack contains:
3 types of carts, 2 spline-ready pipe pieces, 1 missile rack, 1 storage container, 2 storage container doors, 1 blast wall / divider***
